notes.subject: bɛ
notes.rationale: Hebrew יקח can be read as perfect or imperfect; the bɛ marker fixes present, matching jps 'receiveth'.

notes.subject: Yawe tun mɛnna / Yawe na ta
notes.rationale: Both verbs lack explicit tense; a fully past reading ('heard, received') is equally defensible.

notes.subject: Yawe ... Yawe
notes.rationale: The doubled Name frames the two parallel clauses; parallelism kept by repeating Yawe in both lines.

translation: Yawe mɛnna n ka dilanyini; Yawe bɛ n ka jalaki ta.
